# DL Anything You Want

Free, self-hostable downloader and converter for permitted Facebook, Instagram, Threads, TikTok and YouTube media. Outputs MP4 video, MP3 audio, PNG images and local multilingual TEXT transcripts where available.

## Languages

- Traditional Chinese: https://jacbus1.github.io/dl-anything-you-want/
- English: https://jacbus1.github.io/dl-anything-you-want/en/

## Source and author

- Source: https://github.com/jacbus1/dl-anything-you-want
- Author: JACKY H. (@jacbus1): https://github.com/jacbus1

The public GitHub Pages site is the frontend. Media extraction requires the separately running backend. Download only content you own or have permission to use.
